name: 92401 · Sn Bernrdno, CA
findings: ZIP 92401 (Sn Bernrdno) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92401 (Sn Bernrdno) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92401 (Sn Bernrdno) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22.5 times the typical level).
